xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4728: pstack as a skill pack: mount Cursor's Claude Code build from the eltmon/plugins fork (subfolder plugin root)

plan.title: pstack as a skill pack: mount Cursor's Claude Code build from the eltmon/plugins fork (subfolder plugin root)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The operator wants poteto's pstack skills (principle-*, unslop, tdd, architect, poteto-mode) as an Overdeck skill pack with global/project/issue/conversation toggles. pstack's Claude Code build lives in a subfolder (harness/pstack/claude-code) of the eltmon/plugins fork, but the claude-plugin adapter only reads a plugin at the repo root, the mount copies only skill dirs (so 23 skills' link to ../../docs/harness/claude-code.md dangles), and `pan skills pack add` requires an explicit url and --ref.
narratives.Proposal: Add KnownPack.pluginRoot: readPackManifest reads the plugin under that subfolder and returns repo-relative skill dirs so treeHash and the mount work unchanged; extractCommit archives only that subtree. Add KnownPack.mountExtras so the mount copies the plugin's docs/ and README.md next to skills/. Add KNOWN_PACKS.pstack pointing at https://github.com/eltmon/plugins pinned to ae5650febf4320793844c12c4adaa937f417f8da with 7 opt-in skills, and let `pan skills pack add <id> [url]` default the url and ref from KNOWN_PACKS. Verify live on this host with the workspace CLI at project level, then document in features/skills.mdx and changelog.mdx. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4728.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No --plugin-root CLI flag or registry field; pluginRoot comes from KNOWN_PACKS only
- No mounting of agents/, hooks, MCP servers or commands, and Overdeck never runs pack scripts
- No changes to the eltmon/plugins fork and no issues, PRs, comments or fetches against cursor/* or poteto/*
- No mount of the Cursor source tree (pstack/) and no Codex-specific build
- No dashboard changes (the add-command hint stays the mattpocock literal)
- No change to skillsRoot semantics or to the sageox, mattpocock or deft pack behavior
- No gstack runtime work (PAN-4727)
- Nothing left turned on after live verification; pstack stays registered and off

autoDecisions.summary: Add KnownPack.pluginRoot and keep skillsRoot separate rather than generalising skillsRoot
autoDecisions.rationale: pluginRoot relocates the manifest, capability probes and license; folding sageox into it would move its probes to extensions/ and could change its Not-applied output, which the acceptance forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: Pin KNOWN_PACKS.pstack.ref to the fork commit ae5650febf4320793844c12c4adaa937f417f8da
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names it as the fork point and requires an operator-approved pinned commit; fork main equals it today, and a SHA ref disables update nagging until the operator re-pins.

autoDecisions.summary: Opt-in: setup-pstack, automate-me, reflect, create-verification-skill, create-formal-verification-skill, maintain-verification-skill, make-bot-ui
autoDecisions.rationale: Each writes outside the task's diff (user-global ~/.claude/rules, new or edited skill files, PRs, or a Tailscale-exposed webhook UI). poteto-mode stays default because the operator named it and it is user-invoked only; its PR playbooks are documented.

autoDecisions.summary: Mount docs/ and README.md from the plugin root as mount extras
autoDecisions.rationale: 23 skills link ../../docs/harness/claude-code.md, the doc that maps Cursor names to Claude Code, and it tells the agent to read local copies instead of fetching cursor/plugins URLs, which the operator forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: Make the url and --ref of `pan skills pack add` optional, defaulting from KNOWN_PACKS
autoDecisions.rationale: The acceptance runs `pan skills pack add pstack` with no other arguments; only pstack gets a default ref, so other packs still require --ref.

autoDecisions.summary: Live verification uses the workspace CLI against the real host config at project panopticon-cli, reverted to inherit
autoDecisions.rationale: The deployed pan lacks this code; PAN-4424 set the precedent of registering on the host (registration enables nothing) and verifying a level inside a short window.
